title: Generative AI and linguistic diversity in academic writing and publishing: Perspectives from World Englishes

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation through structured scholarly dialogue, literature review, and ad-hoc prompting experiments (e.g., requesting text to be rewritten in Nigerian English) to assess how generative AI models handle and often marginalize non-dominant World Englishes in favor of standard American English.

Scholarly reflection and theoretical analysis evaluating how generative AI models enforce Western, Eurocentric epistemic norms and overrepresent WEIRD (Western, educated, industrialised, rich, and democratic) demographics, thereby flattening cultural nuances and marginalizing Global South and indigenous knowledge systems.
